content: I want to add extra CSS to a verso manual file. I see how it is internally in the manual but cannot figure out how to actually set the metadata. Should it be in a common Lean file, a toml file or somewhere else?

Indeed I went back to my earlier question on cross-referencing and now cannot find {ref "tag"} anywhere. I don't know if it disappeared in an update. As this is the documentation, it would really help if it showed quickly how to do things.

It's been ages since I set up the stylesheets for my project, but I think what I did was add an extraCssFiles entry to the config, something like this:

def someCss : CssFile where
  filename := "some.css"
  contents := include_str "path/to/some.css"

def config : RenderConfig where
  extraCssFiles := { someCss }

Then the file referenced by the string is just an ordinary css file.

If you're working with manual and you haven't already located this, you'll probably find it hugely helpful.

If I misunderstood the question and you're still having problems, let me know. I'm by no means a verso expert, but I'll help if I can.

Siddhartha Gadgil said:

I want to add extra CSS to a verso manual file. I see how it is internally in the manual but cannot figure out how to actually set the metadata. Should it be in a common Lean file, a toml file or somewhere else?

Part metadata is set right after the start of a chapter/section/subsection, inside %%%. They contain Lean structure initializer syntax (that is, field := val).

There's not really a way to add CSS to a particular file per se. There's not a one-to-one correspondence between HTML files and Lean files - just as with LaTeX, a section or subsection can be defined in its own Lean file and included. If you'd like to add CSS to the whole book, then what @David Kinkead describes is a great way to get it to emit a CSS file and reference it via a <link> tag. You can also set the extraCss field to emit inline stylesheets - then you don't need to give it a filename. This is less good for caches but may be simpler if it's just a small tweak you'd like to make.

I've also rectified the oversight and added ref to the Verso manual. Thank you!
